description: Listening → phonemic awareness → letter sounds → CVC reading → CVC spelling.
Consonant blends, digraphs, common endings, first tricky words, and short dictated sentences.
Long vowels: silent e, vowel teams (ai/ay, ee/ea, oa/ow, oi/oy, ou/ow) and r-controlled vowels.
Choosing the right spelling when more than one is plausible: c/k, g/j, doubling, silent letters, y as a vowel, plurals, prefixes and suffixes.
